meta.systemPrompt: You are a squad agent. Use the available tools to complete the user's task. Read files before editing them, prefer targeted actions over broad sweeps, and stop once the task is done.

messages.content: I need to migrate the hardcoded environment variables in our Kubernetes deployment to a ConfigMap. Please look at /infrastructure/k8s/api-deployment.yaml, then create a plan using the task list to track this migration. Start with the first step.

content.text: I'll start by exploring the directory to locate the Kubernetes configuration files.
Now I will read the deployment file to identify which environment variables need to be moved.

content.text: I've identified four environment variables (DB_HOST, DB_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, FEATURE_FLAGS) that should be moved. I'll now create a series of tasks to track the migration process.

input.subject: Define ConfigMap for API settings
input.description: Create a new config-map.yaml file containing DB_HOST, DB_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, and FEATURE_FLAGS.

input.subject: Refactor Deployment to use envFrom
input.description: Update api-deployment.yaml to use the new ConfigMap via envFrom instead of hardcoded env values.

input.subject: Verify migration with dry-run
input.description: Run kubectl apply --dry-run=client to ensure the new configuration is valid.

content.text: Tasks have been created. I will now mark the first task as in-progress to begin the migration.

I have successfully planned the migration of environment variables to a ConfigMap. I created three tasks to track the definition of the ConfigMap, the refactoring of the Deployment, and the final verification. I have also claimed and started the first task: 'Define ConfigMap for API settings'.
